Azure Government note: Aggregation patterns are Gov-ready / Verify for source. DirectQuery source behavior, gateway, connector support, and tenant settings must be validated before this is required.

Detail table: FactSales, at the SalesOrderLineKey grain (one row per order line).

Proposed aggregation grain: Month (DimOrderDate[YearMonth]) x ProductCategory (DimProductCategory[ProductCategory]) x Territory (DimTerritory[TerritoryName]), summarizing Sales Amount, Gross Margin, and Order Count.

Mapping (conceptual): the aggregation table's Month/ProductCategory/Territory columns map to the corresponding detail-table foreign keys through the existing FactSales -> DimOrderDate/DimProduct/DimTerritory relationships shown in the table on the left; the aggregation's Sales Amount/Gross Margin map to SUM(FactSales[SalesAmount])/SUM(FactSales[GrossMargin]); Order Count maps to DISTINCTCOUNT(FactSales[SalesOrderLineKey]).

Aggregation hits: a visual or query that only needs Month/ProductCategory/Territory-level summarization (matching or coarser than the aggregation grain) can be answered entirely from the smaller aggregation table.

Aggregation misses: any query that filters or groups by a column not present in the aggregation (for example CustomerName, Day-level dates, or SalesOrderLineKey) must fall back to the full FactSales detail table.
